name: codebase-intel
description: Four skills for building an accurate picture of a codebase and the libraries it depends on, before committing to a change. codebase-health surfaces complexity hotspots, churn, and bus factor when onboarding or planning a refactor; codebase-architecture-scanner generates layered architecture documentation with C4 and sequence diagrams; grill-with-docs challenges a plan against the existing domain model and sharpens terminology; and read-the-damn-docs stops guesses about third-party API behavior by going to the current documentation first.

interface.shortDescription: Understand a codebase before you change it
interface.longDescription: Four skills for building an accurate picture of a codebase and the libraries it depends on, before committing to a change. codebase-health surfaces complexity hotspots, churn, and bus factor when onboarding or planning a refactor; codebase-architecture-scanner generates layered architecture documentation with C4 and sequence diagrams; grill-with-docs challenges a plan against the existing domain model and sharpens terminology; and read-the-damn-docs stops guesses about third-party API behavior by going to the current documentation first.
capabilities: Reports complexity hotspots, churn, and bus factor for a repository
Generates layered architecture docs with C4 and sequence diagrams
Challenges a plan against the existing domain model and terminology
Grounds third-party API and library behavior in current documentation
